summary: Master enterprise stress testing with scenario design, PD/LGD/EAD analysis, and board-ready reporting. Enrol to build practical risk tools.
lede: Enterprise stress testing and scenario analysis assess how adverse but plausible scenarios affect portfolios, liquidity and capital planning. For enterprise risk, credit, liquidity and capital-planning professionals, the course develops a practical method to build scenarios, quantify stressed exposures using PD, LGD and EAD, and interpret portfolio vulnerabilities for management reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work directly with enterprise risk data, stress assumptions, capital planning, or risk committee reporting and need a stronger operational method for scenario analysis. Enterprise risk analysts who prepare scenario analysis packs and stress summaries. Scenario analysts who convert macro shocks into portfolio impacts. Credit risk managers who review PD, LGD, and EAD stress outputs. Liquidity risk officers who assess funding and run-off pressures. Capital planning specialists who link stress results to capital adequacy. ERM managers who coordinate cross-functional stress testing governance. Risk reporting specialists who prepare board packs and committee papers. Validation analysts who review assumptions, controls, and documentation quality. Treasury analysts who test balance sheet resilience under adverse conditions. Operational risk practitioners who connect non-financial shocks to enterprise scenarios.
prerequisites: You should bring a laptop and be ready to work with spreadsheet-based exercises and guided templates. Familiarity with risk terminology, portfolio concepts, and management reporting is expected, while prior programming or model-building experience is not required.
